# Wiped Setup 1.1.4
- Update the Mac installer directly from Wiped Setup using Check for Updates. - Updates wait until sign-in and iPhone setup are finished. - Includes the iPhone self-signing fixes for Apple authentication and code verification. - Keeps saved Apple account details and existing pairing records when updating.
Older installers need one manual upgrade to this version. Move Wiped Setup to Applications before using its updater. Updating the Mac installer supplies the latest phone app for your next installation; it does not replace an app already installed on your iPhone.
